content.title: The Drowned Bell
content.theme: A souls delve: a tidal keep whose bell once ordered the sea, now silent. Death teaches, shortcuts are earned, and nothing is explained twice.
content.premise: The bell of Vesper Keep once rang the tide out twice a day, and the causeway ran dry for the pilgrims. Then the bell was cut down and drowned in the keep's own cistern, the wardens hollowed at their posts, and the sea stopped listening. A ferrywoman has landed you on the barrow shore at low water. Climb the keep, raise what was drowned, and ring it — the wardens remember their duty just enough to stop you.

boundary.message: The tide shoves you back toward the barrow shore.
